Recovery across high-dimensional signal regimes. The synthetic K=1 assessment experiment. Red
filled circles denote supported positive cells, open circles denote unsupported positive cells;
upward triangles mark passing null controls and downward triangles mark failed null controls.
The analysis unit is one independently collected synthetic animal; the design is Signal
coefficients use the regime-specific noise reference at n = 24 and p = 100 . Each replicate
requests 19 stratified axis refits. Cell decisions use Wilson 95% confidence intervals over all
100 requested replicates in each complete cell. Positive support requires recovery at least 0.9
and a Wilson lower bound at least 0.8 ; passing null controls require recovery no greater than
0.05 and a Wilson upper bound no greater than 0.1 . Claim status is implementation proof only ;
the map describes only the frozen feature counts, signal coefficients, covariance regimes, and
sample size.
